::: {.page-lead}
I work on world models and generative modeling, with the aim of building
general-purpose robots that learn and adapt in real settings. I completed the
M2 Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence at Université Paris-Saclay in 2026,
and the coursework of CentraleSupélec's Engineering Degree in Mathematics and
Data Science.
:::

From January 2027, I join Yuejiang Liu's LEMA group at the National University
of Singapore for a six-month research position in robot learning. Before that,
I worked as an apprentice: Generative AI Engineer at MBDA from 2025 to 2026,
and Data Scientist at TotalEnergies' Digital Factory from 2023 to 2025, on
electric-vehicle charging. This site covers only public research and
deliberately excludes non-public professional work.

## Outside research

Most of my free time goes to history and geopolitics. I like the periods when
energy, industry and logistics changed what a country could do: the Industrial
Revolution, the Second World War as a contest of production, the Cold War, the
globalization of supply chains. I also read about strategy and the defense
industry, from Clausewitz to the Cold War.

Economics and finance come with it: growth, money and markets decide what gets
built and where. I like to understand how a price actually forms in a market,
and how capital moves between industries and countries.

Physics is the other side. I studied quantum and materials physics at
CentraleSupélec, and I still follow quantum mechanics and the physics of
semiconductors, the layer under every chip.

I follow politics through institutions: how a decision is actually made, and
who pays for it. I think about ecology the same way, as a system with physical
limits that reacts to what we do.

### Books

Chris Miller, *Chip War*; Zbigniew Brzezinski, *The Grand Chessboard*; Carl von
Clausewitz, *On War*; Cédric Villani, *Birth of a Theorem*; Frank Herbert,
*Dune* and *Dune Messiah*; William Gibson, *Neuromancer*.

### Films and series

- Machines and minds: *WALL·E*, *Interstellar*, *2001: A Space Odyssey*,
  *Ghost in the Shell*, *Gattaca*.
- Resources, industry and nature: *Dune* and *Dune: Part Two*, *Princess
  Mononoke*, *Once Upon a Time in the West*, *The Wind Rises*.
- Power and systems: *Chernobyl*, *Dr. Strangelove*, *The Hunt for Red
  October*, *The Big Short*.

I also play chess, around 1750 on chess.com.
